task.expectedCommitBoundary: fix(cli): compute the distance from the complete standard input

instructions: Bug: when the CLI reads its two words from standard input, cli.js computes a result for every `data` chunk instead of for the whole input. Input that arrives in more than one chunk (for example `sturgeon`, then ` urgently` written 200 ms later) prints the usage text and exits with code 1 instead of printing `6`. Fix cli.js so it accumulates standard input and computes the distance once, when the input ends. Keep every other behaviour unchanged: the argument path, -i/--insensitive, -h/--help, -v/--version, and the usage error for fewer or more than two words. Add a new, separate test (its own top-level test() call) at the end of test.js that writes `sturgeon` to the CLI's standard input, waits at least 100 ms, then ends the input with ` urgently`, and asserts no error, stdout `6\n`, and empty stderr. Do not change the existing tests.
